title: Hadi Khalaf awarded Kempner Graduate Fellowship
body: Hadi was awarded a Graduate Fellowship from the Kempner Institute for the Study of Natural and Artificial Intelligence at Harvard.

title: Carol Long and Juan Felipe Gomez defend their Ph.D.s
body: Congratulations to Dr. Carol Long, who is joining the ETH Zurich AI Center as a Postdoctoral Fellow, and Dr. Juan Felipe Gomez, who is joining the Hasso Plattner Institute as a Postdoctoral Fellow.

title: Oral presentation at ICLR 2026
body: Our paper "Temporal Sparse Autoencoders: Leveraging the Sequential Nature of Language for Interpretability" was selected for an oral presentation at ICLR 2026.

title: Lucas Monteiro Paes defends his Ph.D.
body: Lucas successfully defended his doctoral thesis and will be joining Apple in June.

title: AI in Brazil Panel Series
body: Professor Calmon organized the AI in Brazil Panel Series, highlighting AI research and opportunities in Brazil.

title: Best Paper Award at NENLP
body: Our paper "AI Alignment at Your Discretion" won the Best Paper Award at NENLP.

title: Thomas D. Cabot Associate Professorship
body: Professor Calmon was named the Thomas D. Cabot Associate Professor of Electrical Engineering.

title: James L. Massey Research & Teaching Award
body: Professor Calmon received the 2024 James L. Massey Award from the IEEE Information Theory Society, recognizing outstanding achievement in research and teaching by young scholars.

title: Lucas Monteiro Paes named Apple Scholar
body: Lucas Monteiro Paes was named an Apple Scholar in AI/ML.

title: New research funding
body: Two new NSF awards, on approximate coded computing and on information theory and differential privacy, and a Harvard Brazil Lemann Research Award on algorithmic discrimination in education.

links.label: NSF: information theory and differential privacy

title: PhD defenses
body: Dr. Hsiang Hsu and Dr. Wael Alghamdi successfully defended their Ph.D. dissertations.

title: Symposium on Machine Learning and Information Theory
body: Professor Calmon organized a symposium at the 2022 Congresso Nacional de Matemática Aplicada e Computacional in Campinas, Brazil.

title: Meta Research PhD Fellowship Spotlight
body: Hsiang Hsu's research on predictive multiplicity and the Rashomon effect was featured as the Meta Research PhD Fellowship Spotlight.

title: ISIT 2022 Tutorial
body: Professor Calmon organized a tutorial on "Information-Theoretic Tools for Responsible Machine Learning" with Haewon Jeong, Shahab Asoodeh, and Mario Diaz.

title: Hao Wang defends his Ph.D.
body: Dr. Hao Wang defended his Ph.D. and joined the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab in Cambridge.
